description: Compile a POM suite on disk (.swipium/suites/<suite>.yaml) into runnable flows under .swipium/flows/ and validate them. No session needed; qa_generate target:"suite" already compiles what it generates.

force.description: Overwrite .swipium/flows/<slug>.yaml even when it was edited by hand since the last compile (default: keep it, write <slug>.yaml.new).

name: qa_flow_compile
title: Compile a POM suite to runnable flows
